claude.sample_unit: patients (20% manual reference standard subset of 3053 CRC patients)

links.outcome: Accuracy of rule-based LLM versus standard Taiwan Cancer Registry process against manual reference
links.effect: Rule-Based LLM achieved 90.7% accuracy, comparable to standard TCR processes (92.0%), with 77.2% sensitivity.
links.quote: Under a strict 60-day temporal tolerance, the Rule-Based LLM achieved 90.7% accuracy, comparable to standard TCR processes (92.0%), and 77.2% sensitivity.

links.outcome: Specificity of raw LLM versus LLM with clinical validation rules against manual reference standard
links.effect: Clinical validation rules significantly improved specificity from 87.7% (Raw LLM) to 93.9% (Rule-Based LLM).
links.quote: The application of clinical validation rules significantly improved specificity from 87.7% (Raw LLM) to 93.9% (Rule-Based LLM).

unlisted_practices: Applying rule-based clinical validation post-processing to LLM outputs to improve specificity
Deploying a local privacy-preserving LLM for registry abstraction
